item.title: LOT-109: image viewer and HD gallery
item.body:
LOT-109
Closes #200
Closes #158
Claim: cloud/lot-109

Idea and feedback credit: Bybifok (moust4ki), FEAT-014.

## Problem
Tapping a picture in the reader did nothing: no full-screen view, no zoom, no swipe, thumbnails stay blurry.

## What changed
- `reader.js` posts a new typed `image` message (`ReaderBridgeMessage.image`, decoded whole or rejected whole) on a tap of a loaded `img.hfrplusimg`; closed spoilers, smileys, avatars and placeholders are not listed.
- `ReaderWebController.openViewer` + `ImageGallery.build` re-apply policy C (consent set, setting, blocked hosts): the page's list is a claim. A neighbour the user never allowed never enters the gallery.
- `ImageViewerModel` (`@Observable @MainActor`) + `ImageViewerView`: full screen, swipe between the page's pictures, zoom, Fermer always visible, share (bytes), save to Photos, copy link. Selected image and neighbours only are held in memory.
- Full-size URL from the LOT-056 host table (thumbnail as fallback); downloads via `ReaderImageFetcher` (cookie-less), `Referer` only per host rule and per hop. Decoding in the app is bounded (`ViewerImageCheck`: 100 MP, 4096 px sample).
- `FilteredPostsView` opens the same viewer; both screens keep their page alive while the cover is up.
- Docs: `docs/features/FEAT-014.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-109-image-viewer.md` (legacy pointers @ 2440d79), `CHANGELOG-LEGACY` #64.

## Scope notes for the orchestrator
- `docs/LOTS.md` listed the swipe gallery as LOT-176 (#416, M5); issue #200 includes it, so it is here. I edited the LOT-109 row only; rows 297 and 310 (LOT-176) and `FEATURES.md` status still need your decision.
- Pending capture #134 (reho.st Referer today, hosts answering the full-size URL), listed in FEAT-014.

## Tests
`ImageGalleryTests`, `ImageViewerModelTests`, `ImageViewerCheckTests`, `ReaderImageViewerBridgeTests` (decoder, controller filtering, Referer per hop, a real `WKWebView` test of the `reader.js` tap). No test waits on a clock (`settle()`). SwiftLint `--strict` clean locally. **Not run:** the app cannot be built or tested from Linux, so the "fails without the change" check and `xcodebuild` on iPhone 18 Pro / iPad are left to CI and the Mac.

## Reviews (Opus, 3 rounds)
R1, R2, R3: REQUEST CHANGES each; all blocking findings fixed. Not fixed (low): the downsample runs on the main thread in `updateUIView`.

## Mac check needed
For `mac/m2-lead`:
- [ ] iPhone 18 Pro and iPad simulators (iOS 27.0): `xcodebuild build test` green; confirm it compiles (typed throws, `Transferable` conditions, ImageIO keys were reviewed by reading only).
- [ ] Tap a picture: viewer opens, Fermer reachable on iPad (touch and pointer), pinch and double-tap zoom, wide image centred at zoom 1, rotation.
- [ ] Swipe through a photo topic: HD loads, thumbnail fallback, "Réessayer", memory stays flat.
- [ ] Reader keeps its pictures after closing the viewer (also from the filtered-posts sheet).
- [ ] Save to Photos (permission prompt, denied, success banner); Share sheet offers Save Image with a JPEG, PNG, GIF; Copier le lien pastes the address.
- [ ] `reho.st` image still needs the forum Referer (capture #134); host-table full-size rewrites on `img3.super-h.fr` and `rehost.diberie.com`.
- [ ] Animated GIF/WebP shows as a still (known limit).
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; Wi-Fi/Jamais settings: a never-allowed neighbour is not swipeable.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CJG2LC3Qfnh2DM1imG)_

comments.body:
Walkthrough

This change adds a page-wide image gallery and full-screen viewer. The reader sends eligible image URLs and the selected index to the app. The app filters the gallery, fetches and validates images, and supports paging, zoom, sharing, saving, and link copying. **Changes: Page image gallery and viewer** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Reader bridge and gallery policy**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Resources/reader.js`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderWebController.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ReaderWebController+Viewer.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ImageGallery.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ImageGalleryTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ReaderImageViewerBridgeTests.swift`|The reader sends original URLs for eligible loaded images and the selected index. The bridge validates the message. The controller applies consent and image policy before emitting a gallery event. Tests cover message validation, gallery filtering, host rewrites, and reader tap handling.| |**Image downloads and state management**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderImageFetcher.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ImageViewerModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ImageViewerServices+Live.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ImageViewerModelTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ImageViewerCheckTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ReaderImageViewerBridgeTests.swift`|The model prefetches the selected image and its neighbors, tries a thumbnail if the full-size download fails, and tracks loading, retry, copy, and save state. Live services use the host table, validate image data and dimensions, and save through add-only Photos authorization. Tests cover download state, validation, save feedback, and request headers.| |**Reader presentation and viewer controls**
`App/SwiftHFR/FilteredPosts/FilteredPostsView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ImageViewerView.swift`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `docs/features/FEAT-014.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-109-image-viewer.md`|Both reader views present the viewer from the image event and avoid stopping the reader while it is open. The viewer provides paging, zoom, close, share, save, and copy-link controls. The documentation describes the feature and its request and image-handling rules.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Reader as reader.js participant Controller as ReaderWebController participant Gallery as ImageGallery participant Screen as TopicReaderView participant Model as ImageViewerModel participant Fetcher as ReaderImageFetcher Reader->>Controller: Send image URLs and selected index Controller->>Gallery: Build gallery using consent and image policy Gallery-->>Controller: Return filtered images and selected index Controller-->>Screen: Emit image event Screen->>Model: Create viewer model Model->>Fetcher: Fetch selected image and neighboring images ``` **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#328](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/328) — Requests review of LOT-109’s cookie-less image fetch and `reho.st` Referer behavior against pending capture `#134`. - [ezzz/HFRnow#134](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/134) — Covers the cookie-less `reho.st` request behavior that the viewer’s host rules use. - [ezzz/HFRnow#416](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/416) — Requests an HD gallery with swipe navigation, which this change adds. - [ezzz/HFRnow#436](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/436) — Covers image host-table and `reho.st` Referer rules used by viewer downloads. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#463](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/463): Adds the reader bridge decoder that this change extends with the image message. - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257): Adds the reader image policy and fetcher used and extended by this change. - [ezzz/HFRnow#464](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/464): Adds `FilteredPostsView.swift`, which this change updates to present the viewer. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot` **Suggested reviewers:** `moust4ki`
Merge Risk: Low · up to a1512

The gallery can include an image still loading, and copied links can point to thumbnails after an HD download fails. These limited issues can be addressed in follow-up.
Security architecture risk: Moderate · up to a1512

The gallery retains an external-image loading decision made when it opens. After a Wi-Fi-to-cellular transition, later swipes can therefore start downloads that the current Wi-Fi-only preference would not allow automatically. Initial image filtering, cookie-less downloads, redirect checks and image-size limits substantially contain the exposure. **Retained concerns** - **Medium · security · inferred:** Gallery authorization can outlive the current external-image policy. Opening the gallery while Wi-Fi-only automatic loading is permitted records allowsThirdParty in every admitted entry. After switching to cellular, swiping beyond the prefetched window starts new full-size requests using that old permission, without distinguishing explicit per-image consent from automatic-loading permission. Poster-chosen hosts can consequently receive the device's new IP address and request timing even though automatic loading is no longer permitted on the current connection. Initial gallery eligibility remains enforced; the regression concerns later request authorization, not initial admission or credential disclosure.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The identified policy-lifetime exposure is per reader device and open gallery, not a shared service or tenant-wide compromise. A poster controls candidate image destinations, but gallery admission requires an eligible reader action and policy state. Later requests can disclose current network identity and timing; the inspected path does not add account cookies or account-session authority. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _inferred_ — A poster can supply external images that enter a gallery under Wi-Fi automatic-loading permission. If the connection later becomes cellular, paging to an uncached position starts another request using the captured permission. The existing inline path instead reads the live setting when admitting each image request. All gallery entries were eligible when admitted, which limits but does not remove the later-request privacy regression. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Blocked destinations are reclassified at every redirect hop. A consented third-party image can redirect to another non-blocked third-party host, but the same permission rule predates the viewer in the inline path; it is not retained as a new PR concern. Sharing passes downloaded bytes rather than a URL for an uncontrolled system fetch, and Photos writes require add-only authorization. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The viewer reuses the existing URL classifier and downloader instead of introducing a separate network policy. Cancellation and bounded decoding provide failure containment, but immutable gallery entries collapse explicit consent and temporary automatic-loading permission into one Boolean, creating the policy-lifetime mismatch.

**Explanation** [`#200`, `#158`] The reader bridge, policy-filtered ImageGallery, and ImageViewerView implement the HD gallery and page-image navigation. The viewer supports zoom, sharing, Photos saving, and link copying. ReaderImageFetcher applies cookie-less requests and host-table Referer rules per hop. ImageViewerModel is `@Observable` and `@MainActor`, and the PR adds model, gallery, image validation, and bridge tests.
